learning_objective: 🎯 Let us take a fun trip to the farm and meet all our cute animal friends!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A farm is a big place with lots of green grass. Many friendly animals live here together happily!
The cow gives us fresh milk. The duck loves to swim in the cool pond water.
Farm animals talk in their own special way. The dog says bow-wow and the hen says cluck-cluck!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Farm Drawing
fun_activity.instructions: Draw your favorite farm animal on a piece of paper and make its funny sound loudly!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned the names of many cute farm animals.
⭐ We learned about the funny sounds our animal friends make.
